{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The EV-IIs more that compensated for the personality flaws evident in the first generation EVs; I used to own a standard EV when I was running an automated bulk freighter. Shortly before I upgraded to an EV-II, my supervisory droid managed to mistreat the droid crew so badly that one of the more aggressive astromechs actually blew it out of the airlock.|Hyrum-12|<ref name="Droids">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>}}
'''Hyrum-12''' was an individual who, while operating an automated [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]], owned an [[EV-series supervisor droid/Legends|EV-series supervisor droid]] whose faulty programming caused it to mistreat the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] crew so badly that an aggressive [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] blew it out an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]], forcing them to replace it with an [[EV-II]].<ref name="Droids" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hyrum-12 was first mentioned in ''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]'', a [[1997]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] sourcebook cowritten by [[Drew Campbell]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Droids" />
